name: United States
description: Follow United States, a tracked place, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: The Uplift: The American Dream
changes.summary: We celebrate the United States ahead of its 250th anniversary with stories about American heroes and pastimes. The founder of e.l.f. Cosmetics shares how he made a massive life change to become a Catholic priest.

changes.title: How does Make America Healthy Again hold up against scientific scrutiny?
changes.summary: Nature, Published online: 23 July 2026; doi:10.1038/d41586-026-02024-3 Researchers share their views on the US health policy spanning topics from vaccines to nutrition.

changes.title: A Fallen Soldier’s Angst, Love and Longing to Return Home From the Iran War
changes.summary: Sgt. Michael Emmanuel Swinton was killed in recent days, one of 18 U.S. soldiers who have lost their lives since the beginning of the war in Iran.

changes.title: Trump imposes new tariffs on dozens of countries, citing forced labor concerns
changes.summary: The Trump administration will impose tariffs of up to 12.5% on goods from 60 U.S. trading partners accused of failing to crack down on forced labor, extending the administration's tariffs on much of the world.

changes.title: Tree of Life rabbi Jeffrey Myers bids farewell 8 years after deadliest antisemitic attack in U.S. history
changes.summary: Rabbi Jeffrey Myers is retiring from Tree of Life Congregation in Pittsburgh, which he led through the aftermath of the deadliest antisemitic attack in U.S. history.

changes.title: Morning news brief
changes.summary: U.S.-Iran strikes escalate, affecting global energy markets, Trump imposes double-digit tariffs on dozens of countries, Vigil held in Madison, Wisconsin, for man killed by police.

changes.title: Brent Crude Oil Prices Top $100 as Conflict With Iran Drags On
changes.summary: Stocks in Asia were down following a sell-off in the U.S. markets over soaring oil prices, rising borrowing costs and worries about the technology industry.

changes.title: Iran War and Trump’s Tariffs Threaten a Resilient U.S. Economy
changes.summary: As renewed fighting with Iran sends oil and gas prices soaring, President Trump has imposed new global tariffs that could push up prices further.

changes.title: Concerns over U.S. weapons getting depleted as U.S. and Iran continue to trade strikes
changes.summary: As the U.S. builds up forces in the Middle East amid the ongoing war with Iran, there's concern among some officials that U.S. weapons may be getting depleted. It comes as President Trump has threatened new escalations and as the U.S. and Iran continue to trade strikes. Charlie D'Agata reports.

changes.title: Trump imposes new tariffs on dozens of countries, including U.S. allies
changes.summary: President Trump is imposing new tariffs on dozens of countries accused of failing to crack down on forced labor. The tariffs range from 10% to 12.5% and include U.S. allies. Nancy Cordes reports.
